limit_notes: Node cap per piece includes all completed ranks, including rank zero.

The pair guard counts pair occurrences over parents, with multiplicity.
Rank widths count distinct births by parent set, with rank zero first. Offshoots at rank one are separate even if their parents agree.
A finite prefix and its ratios give no conclusion about unbounded growth.
